section1.title: 1. Data Ownership
section1.text: At Anaaj.ai, we operate on a fundamental principle: <0>Your data belongs to you.</0> We do not sell your personal information or agricultural data to third-party marketers. Your soil history, crop data, and voice recordings are used solely to provide more accurate agricultural advice to you.

section2.title: 2. Information Collection
section2.text: We collect information necessary to provide our services, including:
items: Voice recordings (processed to understand your farming queries).
Satellite and GPS data (to provide localized weather and soil insights).
Crop health photos (used for pest and disease diagnosis).

section3.title: 3. Data Security
section3.text: We use industry-standard encryption protocols (SSL/TLS) to protect your data during transmission and storage. Access to your personal data is restricted to authorized Anaaj.ai personnel who require it to provide support and technical improvements.

section4.title: 4. Sharing Information
section4.text: We may share anonymous, aggregated data at a regional level (e.g., broad pest outbreak alerts) with government organizations to help prevent regional crop failures. This data is fully anonymized and cannot be linked back to individual farmers.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights
section5.text: You have the right to request a full copy of your data, or request the deletion of your account and all associated data at any time through our support portal or mobile app settings.

section6.title: 6. Data Deletion Instructions
section6.text: To request immediate deletion of your account and all associated data without using the mobile app, you can email us directly. Please send an email to privacy@anaajai.com with the subject 'Data Deletion Request' and include your registered phone number.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.text: By accessing or using the Anaaj.ai website or mobile application, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to all of these terms, do not use our services.

section2.title: 2. Nature of Advisory Service
section2.text: Anaaj.ai provides agricultural advice based on AI models, satellite data, and user input. While we strive for extreme accuracy, our advice is provided "as is". Agricultural outcomes depend on many factors beyond our control, including extreme weather and implementation methods. We are not liable for any crop results or financial losses.

section3.title: 3. User Responsibilities
section3.text: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide (such as crop type and location). You agree to use the service only for lawful agricultural purposes and not to attempt to reverse engineer or disrupt the AI systems.

section4.title: 4. Intellectual Property
section4.text: All software, brand names, and logos associated with Anaaj.ai are the property of Anaaj.ai Precision Ltd. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive license to use the service for personal or commercial agricultural use.

section5.title: 5. Termination
section5.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or engage in fraudulent activities that threaten the integrity of our advisory models. You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time from the app (Profile > Delete account) or by emailing privacy@anaajai.com.

section6.title: 6. Accounts and Eligibility
section6.text: You must be at least 18 years old, or use the service under the supervision of a parent or guardian, to create an account. You sign in with your mobile number and a one-time password (OTP). You are responsible for all activity on your account and for keeping your phone and OTPs secure. Tell us immediately if you think someone else is using your account.

section7.title: 7. Safe Use of Advice
section7.text: Our guidance on pests, diseases, fertilizers and crop-protection chemicals is general information generated with AI. It is not a laboratory test, a professional diagnosis or a prescription. Before you apply any chemical:
items: Read the product label and follow the manufacturer's instructions and local regulations.
Use protective equipment and keep chemicals away from children, animals and water sources.
Check with your local agriculture officer, agronomist or extension service if you are unsure.
Photo and voice results can be inaccurate, so use your own judgement and test on a small area first.

section8.title: 8. Marketplace Orders and Delivery
section8.text: The Anaaj.ai marketplace lets you order seeds, fertilizers, crop-care products and tools offered by Anaaj.ai and its listed sellers. Product details, prices and availability may change without notice, and we may cancel an order if an item is unavailable or a listing contains an obvious error. You can follow the status of your order in the app (pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered or cancelled). Delivery times are estimates and depend on your location and the delivery partner.

section9.title: 9. Payments
section9.text: Payments in the app are made in Indian rupees (INR) and are processed by our payment partner, Razorpay. Your card, UPI or bank details are handled directly by Razorpay. The price is shown at checkout before you pay. If a payment fails, or money is debited but your order, plan or credits are not confirmed, contact us with your payment ID and we will check and resolve it.

section10.title: 10. Plans, Credits and Top-ups
section10.text: Some features, such as AI chat and crop scans, use credits. Free limits, paid plans and top-up packs are shown in the app with their price and quantity. Credits are for your own use and cannot be transferred, sold or exchanged for cash. The validity of a plan and the availability of credits are shown in the app at the time of purchase. We may change plan benefits, prices or free limits in the future, but a change will not reduce what you have already paid for during its validity period.

section11.title: 11. Cancellations and Refunds
section11.text: You can ask to cancel a marketplace order before it is shipped by contacting us. If a product arrives damaged, defective or different from what you ordered, contact us as soon as possible with your order details and photos, and we will repair, replace or refund it as appropriate. Plans and credits that have already been used are generally not refundable. If you are charged twice, or charged without receiving what you paid for, we will refund the amount. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method, and the time taken depends on your bank or payment provider. Nothing in these terms limits your rights under applicable consumer protection laws.

section12.title: 12. Your Content and Device Permissions
section12.text: You keep ownership of the photos, voice recordings and text you submit. You give Anaaj.ai a limited licence to process them to provide and improve the advice you receive, as described in our Privacy Policy. Do not upload unlawful, offensive or infringing content. The app asks for permission to use your camera and photo gallery (crop photos), microphone (voice questions) and location (local weather and advice). You can turn these off in your device settings, but the related features will then stop working.

section13.title: 13. Third-Party Services
section13.text: The service uses third-party services such as Google (maps, phone verification and notifications), Razorpay (payments) and AI model and speech providers. Their own terms and privacy policies apply when you use them, and we are not responsible for services outside our control.

section14.title: 14. Limitation of Liability
section14.text: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Anaaj.ai is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, including loss of crop, yield, income or profit, arising from your use of the service or your reliance on its advice. Our total liability for any claim relating to the service is limited to the amount you paid us for the order or plan that the claim relates to. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.

section15.title: 15. Governing Law and Disputes
section15.text: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Subject to any right you have as a consumer to bring a claim in another court, the courts at Kota, Rajasthan have jurisdiction over disputes. We encourage you to contact us first so that we can try to resolve any complaint quickly and informally.

section16.title: 16. Changes to These Terms
section16.text: We may update these terms from time to time. The effective date at the top of this page shows the latest version. If a change is significant, we will tell you in the app or on this website. If you keep using the service after a change, you accept the updated terms.
